verified_integrations.name: raft-committed-prefix-to-append-log
verified_integrations.scope: Execute the imported Raft election, majority replication, commit-index advancement and two-replica state-machine application; project the exact committed Put/Delete prefix into the imported database-design-lab workload schema; execute the real durable append-log engine; and require a second database process reopening that log to return state equivalent to both Raft replicas.
verification_contract: real distributed-systems-lab Raft election and majority commit, with at least one raft-commit-advance trace
identical committed-prefix application and converged state on leader n1 and follower n2
fail-closed projection of only supported applied Put/Delete commands through UTF-8 lowercase hexadecimal workload bytes
real database-design-lab db-lab subprocess using its append-log engine
separate database process reopen followed by complete touched-key comparison
machine-checked participant source pins matching the verified import ledger
limitations: does not atomically couple Raft acknowledgement to database sync_data
does not replicate database files or database-design-lab engine internals
does not propagate client deduplication identities, snapshots, SQL or transactions
does not prove arbitrary crash-timing safety, full linearizability, availability, Byzantine tolerance or performance
